mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% in two months signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.04 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business confidence decline.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in two months signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic activity and corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three months signals a strengthening consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings and economic growth improve.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS shows a sustained increase, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.04 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals an inflationary pressure combined with tight monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary period with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this interaction is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% in the same period, it signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investor sentiment improves.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this interaction is below 0.04 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) grows by less than 1% in a quarter and housing starts (HOUST) drop by more than 10% in the same period, it signals a significant weakening in economic demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic pessimism sets in.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 grows < 1% and HOUST drops > 10% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this interaction is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
